question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

ACC, UZD, OWE, ITF, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (6) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59a90f2d1e1160ab691fb64dbb953549b927071945785adaf9afb0f7f52ffced.png] 

Hence, "**CQG**" is the correct answer.
